text:
Sam (sales): FYI Fortuna Capital just escalated to the CEO. They put the POC on hold until we give an exec-level assurance on BYOK + a firm per-request latency SLA for their trading UI. They want a 20-30 minute executive bridge tomorrow. Need a quick internal plan. @Rina @Ethan @Victor
Rina (security): Got the security checklist. Main asks: BYOK key control, real-time audit logs for decrypt ops, and cert that data and model shards never leave eu-central-1. They also asked for a concise one-liner we can give the CEO.
Ethan (eng-runtime): Hosted path supports BYOK via customer KEK + wrapped DEKs. We can pin processing to eu-central-1 nodes for the POC but failover behavior needs to be explicit. Latency SLO: p50 ~45ms, p95 ~120ms on their test profile. I can validate with perf numbers.
Nora (bd): They want a commercial concession if we commit to a tighter SLA for the POC (customer requests credit if p95 > 150ms). Are we willing to consider a temporary SLA or a credit tie?
Victor (legal): I'll draft a short addendum for a POC SLA and BYOK custody statement. Need eng to confirm rotation APIs and audit log retention options (30/90/365 days).
ops-bot: runbook created: /runbooks/fortuna-capital-poc-escalation-1759876543  assigned to @Ethan @Rina @Victor
Rina (security): Quick answer for the CEO: "Redwood will accept customer-managed KEKs; wrapped keys are stored only in encrypted form and keys are never exported in plaintext. For EU data residency we can confine processing to eu-central-1 for the POC; Dedicated/Private provide stronger contractual guarantees." Thoughts?
Ethan (eng-runtime): Agree with Rina. Addendum: "We route POC inference to EU-only nodes and disable cross-region failover unless explicit approval; this reduces autoscaling headroom." I'll attach a one-page flow and p95 numbers in 30m.
Sam (sales): Good. Nora can you confirm what commercial concession they'd expect? I'll push back if it's an open-ended credit.
Nora (bd): They asked for a 20% credit on POC usage if SLA breaches >2 days in a row. That's a bit heavy. Maybe propose a smaller cap (max $X) and limited to the 2-week POC.
Victor (legal): Fine. I'll include a cap and sunset clause (POC only). Also will add: "Customer may rotate KEK at will; Redwood exposes a rotation API and will accept updated wrapped keys without downtime." Need eng confirmation.
Ethan (eng-runtime): Confirm we support asynchronous key rotation via KMS-proxy. Rotation requires a brief cache warm period but no downtime. I'll include technical caveats and estimated latency impact in the doc.
Rina (security): I'll assemble a CEO-ready slide: 1) one-liner BYOK + EU processing, 2) simple diagram of key flow, 3) SLA ask + proposed credit cap, 4) next steps. Will drop by EOD.
Sam (sales): Great. Owners: Rina (CEO slide + security one-liner), Ethan (perf numbers + key-rotation note + arch snippet), Victor (POC addendum draft), Nora (commercial counter-offer). I'll schedule the exec bridge for tomorrow and hold until we have the deck.
ops-bot: calendar placeholder created for 09:30 CET / 00:30 PDT (exec bridge)  please confirm final timing
Ethan (eng-runtime): I'll post perf outputs and a tiny SVG sequence in 40m.
Victor (legal): Draft addendum will be in the runbook path in 2hrs for quick review.
Rina (security): Uploading CEO one-liner + diagram in 2hrs.
Sam (sales): Thanks team. Ping here when assets uploaded and I'll take care of invite + exec pre-brief. :raised_hands:
